featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a fantastic marble temple that was made almost 24 years ago by late Shri.Goenka.
There are too many small small individual temples inside.
The main diety is Radhe & Krishna.
Rest constitutes different Gods of repute and popularity.
They have tried to replicate Tirupati Baghvan as it is seen at Tirupati, the most popular temple in South India.
Here bajan, recitals etc go on incessantly everyday and all are admitted without looking at cast or creed.
The Prasadam - a sort of rice cooked in pure ghee with exotic dry fruits are given freely to devotees after the pooja and usual rituals.
I would say, it's worth visiting once in your life time.

.

featured_reviews.name: Piyush Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
**Shri Siddhivinayak Temple Review**

Nestled in the heart of Mumbai, the revered Shri Siddhivinayak Temple stands as an iconic symbol of devotion, spirituality, and cultural richness. Dedicated to Lord Ganesha, the deity of wisdom and prosperity, this sacred temple holds a profound significance among devotees and visitors from around the globe.

Upon entering the temple complex, one is greeted by the resplendent architecture that exudes a sense of serenity and sanctity. The intricately crafted idol of Lord Ganesha, bedecked with ornate garlands and offerings, serves as the focal point, radiating a sense of divinity and peace to all who come seeking blessings.

The ambiance within the temple premises is filled with the fragrance of incense, the sound of hymns, and the collective hum of prayers, creating an atmosphere steeped in spirituality. Devotees offer their prayers with heartfelt devotion, seeking the blessings of Lord Ganesha for success, prosperity, and overcoming obstacles.

The management of the temple ensures a streamlined darshan (viewing) experience, employing efficient systems to accommodate the large influx of devotees while maintaining the sanctity of the place. The efficient crowd management and facilities provided for the devotees' comfort contribute significantly to the overall experience.

Moreover, the temple's philanthropic initiatives and charitable endeavors, aimed at various social causes and community welfare projects, reflect its commitment to serving society beyond its religious significance.

However, due to its immense popularity, the temple often witnesses long queues, especially during auspicious days and festivals, which might pose a challenge for visitors seeking a quick darshan.

In essence, the Shri Siddhivinayak Temple stands as a beacon of faith and spirituality, offering solace and blessings to all who step into its sacred precincts, making it a must-visit destination for those seeking divine grace and inner peace.

featured_reviews.name: Rinky Saw
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the privilege of visiting Mahalakshmi Mandir, and I must say it was an experience that left me awe-inspired and spiritually rejuvenated. Nestled in the heart of [location], this sacred temple is dedicated to the Hindu goddess Mahalakshmi, the divine embodiment of wealth, prosperity, and abundance.

From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted by a serene and tranquil atmosphere. The temple's architecture is a beautiful blend of traditional and contemporary styles, featuring intricate carvings, vibrant paintings, and exquisite sculptures that depict various mythological tales. The attention to detail and craftsmanship is truly remarkable, creating an ambiance that is both aesthetically pleasing and spiritually uplifting.

The main deity, Goddess Mahalakshmi, is enshrined in the sanctum sanctorum, radiating a sense of divine energy. The priests and temple staff were friendly, welcoming, and knowledgeable, providing valuable insights into the significance of the goddess and her worship. The daily rituals and prayers conducted in the temple add a sense of sacredness and devotion to the overall experience.

One aspect that stood out to me was the sense of inclusivity and harmony within the temple. People from all walks of life, irrespective of caste, creed, or nationality, are welcome to seek the blessings of Mahalakshmi. It was heartening to see devotees coming together, united by their faith, and engaging in prayers, meditation, and offerings.

The temple complex is well-maintained, with spacious halls for devotees to sit and meditate. The serene garden surrounding the temple provides a peaceful retreat, away from the bustling city life. Additionally, the temple organizes various spiritual and cultural events throughout the year, enriching the experience for visitors and locals alike.

The vibrant atmosphere during festive occasions, such as Navaratri and Diwali, is truly enchanting. The temple premises come alive with decorations, music, and devotional fervor, making it an ideal time to witness the rich cultural heritage and traditions associated with the goddess.

Overall, my visit to Mahalakshmi Mandir was a profound and uplifting experience. Whether you seek solace, blessings, or simply want to immerse yourself in the divinity of Hindu mythology, this temple offers a remarkable opportunity to connect with the spiritual realm. I highly recommend a visit to Mahalakshmi Mandir to anyone who wishes to embark on a sacred journey and experience the grace and blessings of Goddess Mahalakshmi

featured_reviews.name: Rudra Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited this beautiful Ganpati temple and the experience was honestly unforgettable. The moment you enter the temple परिसर, you feel a very peaceful and positive vibe. The temple is surrounded by such calm and natural beauty that it immediately relaxes your mind. One of the best and most unique parts of this place is the lake beside the temple. The lake makes the entire atmosphere look magical and peaceful, especially during the evening time when the weather becomes cool and the reflection of the temple lights falls on the water. Watching the ducks swimming in the lake adds such a wholesome and soothing feeling to the whole experience. It feels like a perfect combination of spirituality and nature together.
Another thing I really loved is that one more mandir is connected to the main Ganpati temple, which makes the visit even more special. You can peacefully walk from one mandir to another and take blessings at both places together. The architecture and surroundings of both temples are very beautiful and give such positive energy. The entire place is well-maintained, clean, and perfect for families, friends, or even people who just want some peaceful alone time away from the city noise.
The atmosphere here feels very divine and calming. Sitting near the lake for a few minutes after darshan feels extremely relaxing and refreshing. The sound of birds, the peaceful water, and the spiritual environment together create such a different and memorable experience. This is not just a temple but a place where you can genuinely feel peace and positivity.
I would highly recommend everyone to visit this place at least once. Whether you are going for darshan, photography, family time, or just mental peace, this place is perfect in every way. A truly beautiful and serene Ganpati temple experience that stays in your heart even after leaving the place.

featured_reviews.name: yogesh pandey
featured_reviews.review_text: Swayambhu Shree Ganesh Temple is a very peaceful and positive place for darshan—clean premises, calm atmosphere, and overall good management; it’s also easy to reach from Borivali West and feels like a perfect spiritual stop in Mumbai, but one important thing to note is that camera/photography is not allowed inside the temple premises, so please don’t plan to shoot photos or videos during darshan and follow the rules to avoid any issue. Watch my vlog on YouTube: YogiYatraYonder .

Swayambhu Shree Vajira Ganapati Temple, Borivali, is a very peaceful and devotional place. The temple has a calm and positive spiritual atmosphere. During Sankashti, even though there is a heavy rush, the temple management handles the crowd very well with good arrangements and discipline.
One special thing is that during Ganesh Chaturthi, devotees who have Ganapati at home can do the visarjan here, as the temple has a lake for immersion. Overall, it is a wonderful place for prayer and devotion

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Mirashi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting Vazira Ganesh Temple was a profoundly enriching experience. Located in a tranquil corner of the city, this temple serves as a serene oasis, providing a perfect escape from the hectic pace of everyday life.

One of the standout features of Vazira Ganesh Temple is its immaculate maintenance and peaceful ambiance. The temple grounds are meticulously kept, contributing to a serene atmosphere conducive to spiritual contemplation. The architecture is stunning, adorned with intricate carvings that reflect a rich cultural heritage. The vibrant idol of Lord Ganesha is the centerpiece, radiating a palpable sense of divinity and peace.

Overall, my visit to Vazira Ganesh Temple left a lasting impression. It's not just a place of worship but a sanctuary where one can reconnect with spirituality amidst a beautifully preserved environment.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A South Indian Hindu temple/Ayyappa shrine on the serene hillside of Shreenagar/ Shantinagar at Wagle Estate, Thane. During the early 1970s, a few devotees of swamy Ayyappan joined together for prayers and from there the movement started growing until 1977 when the Samiti was registered as a trust and thereafter it continued to spread, grow and attract adherents.

Lots of steps to get to the very top as the temple is located on a slope, Once on top one can get excellent views of some areas of Mumbai which is both beautiful and pleasing. Many people use the open area on top for Yoga, massage therapy or martial arts. The garden seems to be well maintained by the temple. The area appeared clean and many people came in to offer prayers during the time I was there. The temple opens early morning at 5am and closes at 9pm.

featured_reviews.name: Kruti Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: "The experience is completely different from the outside. Once you enter the temple, there is a black stone structure that makes you feel like you are in South India. We had Sunday prashadam served on a banana leaf, and it was very tasty.”

featured_reviews.name: Madhavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sri Ayyappa Swamy Temple in Sai Baba Nagar, Borivali West, is a शांत और पवित्र place that offers a deeply spiritual experience. The temple is well maintained and has a calm, positive atmosphere that helps devotees feel peaceful as soon as they enter. The Ayyappa Swamy idol is beautifully adorned, and the daily poojas and bhajans are conducted with great devotion and discipline. During special occasions like Mandala Pooja and Makara Sankranti, the temple becomes especially vibrant while still remaining well organized. The priests and volunteers are polite and helpful, making devotees feel welcome.

Overall, it is a wonderful place for prayer, meditation, and finding inner peace, especially for Ayyappa devotees and residents nearby.

featured_reviews.name: Surja Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's at walkable distance from Borivali  Rly Stn W/side towards Kandivali beyond Kalpana Chawla Chowk, Near Kalyan Jeweller.
Well maintained by Malyali Samaj has Temple of Aiyappa swamy, Guruvayoor, Ganaoathy & Devi with counters for various services like Pushpanjali, Nilanjana, Archana, etc at fixed rate.
Usually visited on Saturday & by Groups going to Sabarimala darshan.

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth S
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a nice small temple built by the Malayalee community near Sai Baba Colony Borivali west. The temple trustees are nice people who take care of the temple.

featured_reviews.name: Ramaswamy
featured_reviews.review_text: Very divine and peaceful temple. The temple has shrines of lord ayyappa, sri vinayaka, sri anjaneya etc. Regular archanas and Pooja are conducted.  Weekends will be busy, as also the time during devotees planning to visit sabarimala. Really blessed to have received darshan here.

featured_reviews.name: Amita M
featured_reviews.review_text: Really surprised such a beautiful temple exists admist the busy traffic of Borivali. Very well maintained. We had been to a friend's  pooja. After which we were served auntie kerala delicious Prasadam ..and lunch. Loved it. Samiye Sharan Ayyappa

featured_reviews.name: Santosh Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Serenity, Tranquility, Divinity..!! Experienced all of these at this amazing Ayyappa Temple..!! Very peaceful and happy experience..!! Must visit again....🙏😊🌺
